package tracer

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
)

type copyState struct {
	owner                *Span
	operation, resource  string
	ctx                  context.Context
	parent               any
	meta                 map[string]string
	metrics              map[string]float64
	captures, deliveries int
}

var copies []*copyState

func __ddtoMirrorStart(ctx context.Context, parent any, name string) any {
	state := &copyState{ctx: ctx, operation: name, parent: parent}
	copies = append(copies, state)
	return state
}
func __ddtoMirrorContext(ctx context.Context, state any) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, "mirror", state)
}
func __ddtoMirrorCapture(state any, name, service, resource, kind string, start, duration int64, err int32, meta func(func(string, string) bool), metrics map[string]float64, trace [16]byte, id uint64) any {
	copy := state.(*copyState)
	if !copy.owner.mu.held.Load() {
		panic("capture outside SDK lock")
	}
	copy.captures++
	copy.resource = resource
	copy.meta = map[string]string{}
	meta(func(k, v string) bool { copy.meta[k] = v; return true })
	copy.metrics = map[string]float64{}
	for k, v := range metrics {
		copy.metrics[k] = v
	}
	return copy
}
func __ddtoMirrorDeliver(state any) {
	if state == nil {
		return
	}
	copy := state.(*copyState)
	if copy.owner.mu.held.Load() {
		panic("delivery under SDK lock")
	}
	copy.deliveries++
}

func TestFinalFieldsAndLifetime(t *testing.T) {
	copies = nil
	ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), "client", 123)
	span := spanStart("operation", StartSpanConfig{Context: ctx})
	if len(copies) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("creation count: %d", len(copies))
	}
	copy := copies[0]
	copy.owner = span
	if copy.operation != "operation" || copy.ctx.Value("client") != 123 {
		t.Fatal("creation inputs lost")
	}
	linked := ContextWithSpan(ctx, span)
	if linked.Value("mirror") != copy || linked.Value("client") != 123 {
		t.Fatal("context snapshot lost")
	}
	span.finish(10)
	if copy.captures != 1 || copy.deliveries != 1 || copy.resource != "final" || copy.meta["tail"] != "final" || copy.metrics["tail"] != 42 {
		t.Fatalf("final capture: %+v", copy)
	}
	span.resource = "recycled"
	span.meta["tail"] = "recycled"
	span.metrics["tail"] = 99
	if copy.resource != "final" || copy.meta["tail"] != "final" || copy.metrics["tail"] != 42 {
		t.Fatal("capture shares mutable SDK fields")
	}
	span.finish(20)
	if copy.captures != 1 || copy.deliveries != 1 {
		t.Fatal("duplicate finish emitted a copy")
	}
	detached := ContextWithSpan(linked, nil)
	if detached.Value("mirror") != nil || detached.Value("client") != 123 {
		t.Fatal("nil SDK span did not detach")
	}
	disabled := spanStart("disabled", StartSpanConfig{Context: ctx})
	disabled.disabled = true
	skipped := copies[1]
	skipped.owner = disabled
	disabled.finish(30)
	if skipped.captures != 0 || skipped.deliveries != 0 {
		t.Fatal("early return emitted a copy")
	}
}

func TestParentContextAndPanics(t *testing.T) {
	copies = nil
	ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), "client", 123)
	root := spanStart("root", StartSpanConfig{Context: ctx})
	parent := copies[0]
	parent.owner = root
	child := spanStart("child", StartSpanConfig{Parent: root.Context()})
	state := copies[1]
	state.owner = child
	if state.parent != parent || state.ctx.Value("client") != 123 {
		t.Fatal("selected parent context lost")
	}
	child.panicBefore = true
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() == nil {
				t.Error("SDK panic was swallowed")
			}
		}()
		child.finish(10)
	}()
	if state.captures != 0 || state.deliveries != 0 || child.mu.held.Load() {
		t.Fatal("unfinished span copied or lock retained")
	}
	child.panicBefore = false
	child.panicAfter = true
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() == nil {
				t.Error("SDK panic was swallowed")
			}
		}()
		child.finish(20)
	}()
	if state.captures != 1 || state.deliveries != 1 || child.mu.held.Load() {
		t.Fatal("finished span lost or lock retained")
	}
}
